title: Spicy Goan Lassi Soup
description: A creamy and spicy soup inspired by the flavors of Goa, made with a unique blend of yogurt, velvety texture, and a hint of sauerkraut.
instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the chopped goan and sauté until lightly browned.
Add the shredded sauerkraut and cook for 2 minutes.
Pour in the lassi and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the heavy cream and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro if desired.
